title: Instruments
description: Record bench instruments on the same timeline as the device under test, and set them from the app or a notebook.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: One entry per instrument. Auto-configure adds one for each instrument found on the network, on USB and on the serial ports of known instrument vendors.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: auto picks the profile from the instrument's identity. Or choose one, or give the path to your own profile file.

name.title: Name
name.description: How this instrument appears in the trace. Letters, digits, spaces, _ and -. Empty uses the model and serial number.

rate_hz.title: Readings per second
rate_hz.description: How often the measurements are read. The instrument's own turnaround is the floor: ask for more and it reads back to back.

host.title: Host
host.description: An instrument from the list, or a host name or address, with :port when the instrument does not use the profile's port.

port.title: Port
port.description: The raw socket port. Empty uses the profile's default, 5025 for most instruments.

resource.title: Device
resource.description: A USB instrument from the list, or its VISA resource string, such as USB0::0x1AB1::0x0E11::DP8C123::INSTR.

port.title: Port
port.description: A serial port from the list, or a path such as COM7 or /dev/ttyUSB0.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: A VXI-11 or HiSLIP instrument from the list, or a VISA resource string such as TCPIP0::192.168.1.40::inst0::INSTR, TCPIP0::192.168.1.40::hislip0::INSTR or GPIB0::5::INSTR.

backend.title: VISA library
backend.description: Automatic uses the system VISA for USB and GPIB when one is installed, and the built-in library otherwise.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The trace source every instrument publishes under.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: The most the extension will ever set, whatever the instrument allows. A set above a limit is refused.

keep_panel.title: Keep the front panel usable
keep_panel.description: On instruments that lock their front panel while a computer talks to them, hand control back once a second.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Empty uses the count the profile knows for the model.

timeout_s.title: Reply timeout (s)
timeout_s.description: Empty uses the profile's default, 2 s for most instruments.

delay_ms.title: Delay between commands (ms)
delay_ms.description: Empty uses the profile's default. Only some instruments need one.

poll.title: Extra readings
poll.description: Any query whose reply is a number, recorded as its own signal.

query.title: Query
query.description: {ch} is the channel number. A query without it is read once per interval.
